cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.14% · WTI +2.94% · Brent -1.97% · NatGas +12.53%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.39%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.39%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.12%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.52%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.48%, EOSE +5.77%, BE +4.71%, PWR +4.24%, ARRY +2.65%. Laggards: ENPH -16.52%, SEDG -9.51%, BKR -6.73%, NOV -6.25%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.24% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
